items.question: Was Sam Thomas on the WNBA All-Rookie Team?
items.answer: Sam Thomas made the Associated Press WNBA All-Rookie Team in 2022, her rookie year with the Phoenix Mercury. She was not on the league's official 2022 All-Rookie Team, which was Rhyne Howard, Shakira Austin, NaLyssa Smith, Queen Egbo and Rebekah Gardner.

items.question: Did Sam Thomas play in the WNBA?
items.answer: Yes. Sam Thomas went undrafted in 2022 but made the Phoenix Mercury roster and played 24 regular-season games as a rookie. She played one more game for Phoenix early in 2023, and she announced her retirement in September 2023.

items.question: What did Sam Thomas average in the WNBA?
items.answer: Sam Thomas averaged 0.4 points and 0.2 rebounds in 25 WNBA regular-season games for the Phoenix Mercury in 2022 and 2023.

items.question: Where did Sam Thomas play college basketball?
items.answer: Sam Thomas played five seasons at Arizona (2017 to 2022) and started every game of her career there. She left as the program leader in games played (154), won the 2021 Elite 90 Award at the Final Four and made the Pac-12 All-Defensive Team three times.

items.question: How old is Sam Thomas?
items.answer: Sam Thomas was born June 14, 1999, in Las Vegas, Nevada.
